_comment: Shown to users in the 'What's new' sheet after an update, and at the top of the GitHub release notes. Newest release first. Write for listeners, not developers: what they can do now, in a sentence or two. type is new, improved or fixed.

highlights.title: A fresh new look
highlights.text: New icons and a new typeface across the whole app, so Muzik looks the same on every phone.

highlights.title: A new Home
highlights.text: The top card picks up where you left off, with a progress bar and play/pause. Your shortcuts are all in one grid, recent songs show as a compact list, and a Listening stats card at the bottom sums up your plays.

highlights.title: Pin to Home
highlights.text: Pin your favorite albums and playlists from their ⋮ menu: they show up in a Pinned row on Home.

highlights.title: Better album pages
highlights.text: Album pages show the release year and more albums by the same artist. The ⋮ menu lets you queue the whole album, add it to a playlist in one go, or edit its tags.

highlights.title: Smart playlists stand out
highlights.text: Liked Songs, Most Played, Recently Added and Rediscover have new cards, with the cover of their top song in the background.

highlights.title: Next is always there
highlights.text: Next no longer disappears from the notification when you play a single song or reach the last one. On the last song, it takes you back to the start, paused.

highlights.title: Next stays in its place
highlights.text: On some phones, the shuffle button in the notification took the place of Next on the last song. Next now keeps its spot.

highlights.title: Pick your colors
highlights.text: Choose between three themes in Settings: Nocturne, Ember and Lagoon.

highlights.title: Shuffle and repeat from the notification
highlights.text: Turn shuffle on or off and switch repeat right from the player in your notifications, without opening the app.

highlights.title: A queue that makes more sense
highlights.text: Songs you add play right after the current one and stay in the list, so Previous takes you back to them. Shuffle now only mixes the songs still to come.

highlights.title: Muzik Tags: fix your songs' info
highlights.text: A new tag editor, with its own icon in your app drawer. Fix titles, artists, albums, years and covers right inside your files, or a whole album at once.

highlights.title: Add a whole album to the queue
highlights.text: One tap next to Play and Shuffle queues a whole album, playlist, artist or folder.

highlights.title: Quicker "Added to queue"
highlights.text: The confirmation is now small and short, and no longer gets in the way of the next song you want to add.

highlights.title: Back no longer plays a song
highlights.text: Tapping Back on an album or playlist page sometimes started the song underneath. Not anymore.

highlights.title: Settings, all in one place
highlights.text: Tap the gear on Home to manage your folders, library filters, sleep timer and sound settings.

highlights.title: Pull down to refresh
highlights.text: Added new music? Pull down on Home or Songs and Muzik finds it right away.

highlights.title: Play by voice
highlights.text: Ask Google Assistant or Android Auto to "play" an artist, album or song on Muzik.

highlights.title: About Muzik
highlights.text: See which version you have, get the latest one, or tell us about a bug in a couple of taps.

highlights.title: Up to date under the hood
highlights.text: Muzik is now built on the latest Android libraries, so it keeps working well on new phones.
